description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'FileUtil' that provides various file handling operations such as reading, writing, zipping, unzipping, and path normalization, tailored for use within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FileUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for extensive file operations including reading, writing, zipping, unzipping, and path normalization.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for a given path, optionally resolving component:// URLs.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a String to a file, with variants supporting encoding and directory creation.

methods.name: getBufferedWriter
methods.description: Creates a BufferedWriter for a specified file, handling path adjustments.

methods.name: getPatchedFileName
methods.description: Constructs a full filename with directory path, ensuring directory existence.

methods.name: readTextFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a text file into a StringBuffer, optionally adding newlines.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a String with specified encoding.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for files matching a filter, including subfolders if specified.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Finds files with specific extension and content pattern within a base path.

methods.name: findXmlFiles
methods.description: Searches for XML files with given root element or DTD/XSD reference in a directory.

methods.name: containsString
methods.description: Checks if a Reader or a file contains a specific string.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Determines whether a specified path is a file.

methods.name: zipFileStream
methods.description: Generates a zip InputStream from a single file input stream and filename.

methods.name: zipFileStreams
methods.description: Creates a zip InputStream from a map of filenames and InputStreams.

methods.name: newFile
methods.description: Validates and creates a File object from a ZipEntry, preventing Zip Slip vulnerabilities.

methods.name: unzipFileToFolder
methods.description: Extracts a zip file to a specified output folder, optionally handling Zip Slip vulnerabilities.

methods.name: createFileWithNormalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a File object with a normalized file path.

methods.name: normalizeFilePath
methods.description: Returns a normalized string representing a file path.

methods.name: unZip
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive to a destination directory, optionally with password, handling errors gracefully.
